title: Lightly Yeasty British Khus Khus Scones
description: A yeasty and crumbly British dish featuring khus khus, perfect for a kid-friendly snack, this recipe is also FODMAP-friendly. The khus khus adds a unique flavor and texture to the scones.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, khus khus, yeast, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead it a few times until it comes together.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out scones.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Broil the scones for 10-12 minutes, or until they are lightly golden brown.
Remove the scones from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
